---
title: "About"
---

Hello, my name is Fai. I’m a chemical engineering student currently taking a course on nanoparticle synthesis. This site is a place for me to document concepts taught in class, explore them more deeply, and refresh my programming skills along the way.

My workflow usually starts with reviewing class notes and sketching out ideas that I find interesting or worth expanding on. I then prototype figures, simulations, or explanations using IPython in Jupyter notebooks. Once I’m happy with the results, I convert the notebooks to Quarto (`.qmd`) files and publish them here.

Reproducibility is an important part of how I work; most figures and animations are generated directly from code rather than added manually. Posts are written as I learn, and may evolve over time as my understanding improves. Everything here is intended to be both a personal reference and a resource that other students might find useful.
